name: Bunny Optimizer
description: Image toolkit that serves Drupal image-style derivatives through Bunny.net's real-time image optimizer by rewriting image URLs with query parameters instead of processing files locally.
project_description: Bunny Optimizer registers a Drupal image toolkit (plugin id 'bunny_optimizer', selected at Configuration > Media > Image toolkit) that offloads image-style derivative generation to Bunny.net's real-time optimizer CDN. Instead of resizing or converting files on the server, the module keeps your existing image styles but rewrites the derivative URL to point at your Bunny CDN pull-zone hostname with query parameters (width, height, crop, quality, blur, class, etc.) that Bunny applies at the edge. Standard effects Crop, Desaturate, Resize, Scale and Scale-and-crop are re-implemented as toolkit operations that set query parameters; extra Bunny-specific effects (Automatically optimize, Blur, Brightness, Contrast, Flip, Flop, Hue, Quality, Saturation, Sepia, Sharpen, Smart Face Crop) and an 'Apply a Bunny Optimizer image class' preset effect are provided. Requires a Bunny CDN account with a pull zone; the only stored configuration is the CDN hostname. The module makes no server-side calls to Bunny and stores no API credentials.
